messages:
emma: Quick sync — closure checklist for the ACME postmortem. Need clear handoffs for the on-prem peering remediations and a short timeline. Who can own the peering + isolation followups?
raj: I can own the VPC peering fixes. Need customer routing creds and an ACL audit first. ETA hopeful: 2 weeks unless we get creds today.
maria: I will own runbook updates and a minimal repro harness for the isolation bug. Plan: draft by Fri, review Mon.
oliver: From escalations: customer has a maintenance window next Tue. If we can push a canary then that'd be ideal. Also flag: this looks like a recurring pattern — similar root cause in 3 incidents (BGP session resets when onprem NAT + asymmetric routing). Suggest long-term: keepalives + loss detection alerting.
leah: I can coordinate with the customer on access + maintenance window. I’ll update their ticket and confirm availability by EOD.
emma: Action list (short):
  1) Raj - peering ACL audit + patch (owner)
  2) Maria - runbook + repro harness (owner)
  3) Oliver - security/esc review (owner)
  4) Leah - customer coordination (owner)
Can we add owners & ETAs into the tracker? :clipboard:
raj: Adding to tracker now: https://r-internal/tracker/INC-12345 — ETA for patch: 2026-04-09. Note: requires routing-table change and oncall signoff from infra.
oliver: Security note: risk of route leaking if we change advertisement rules. Scheduling quick sec review tomorrow 09:00 PT. @maria please attach draft ACLs to the doc before then.
maria: Draft ACLs posted here:
```
# ACL snippet
allow from 10.0.0.0/16 to 172.31.0.0/16 proto tcp port 22
deny from 0.0.0.0/0 to 172.31.0.0/16
```
Will iterate after sec review.
deploy-bot: Deployed postmortem checklist template to /incidents/closure-templates. PM: emma
emma: Quick timeline check — Raj, if we target customer maintenance window next Tue can you have a canary by Mon EOD for validation? If not we should shift.
raj: Realistic: canary by Tue morning if I get routing creds today. Otherwise next-week. Pinging infra-admins for creds.
infra-admin: Temporary creds granted to raj. Expires in 48h.
leah: Confirmed with customer — they can also provide BGP logs during the maintenance window. I'll add that to the ticket.
emma: Scheduling a 15-min owners check-in Fri 15:00 to verify blockers. Recurring-pattern action: create 'peering-flap-detection' alert (owner: eng-sre). @raj can you draft the alert query?
raj: On it. Draft alert: detect >3 BGP session resets within 1h and increase severity if followed by traffic drop. Will post PR to monitoring tomorrow.
oliver: Also create a remediation-retention doc so future oncalls can see what worked. I'll spin up a template and add a short postmortem summary.
emma: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Final ask — mark items 'blocked' in tracker if dependencies (creds, customer window, sec approval) aren't met. We'll only close when fixes are validated in prod.
